clarification.definition: Spearman correlation between patristic separation and trait-state dissimilarity within a family x trait system.
clarification.interpretation: Larger positive rho means a stronger monotonic erosion of trait-state similarity with phylogenetic separation. It is not a decay constant, half-life, or rate with phylogenetic time units.

scientific_question_effective: Across vascular plant families and traits, is phylogenetic memory-loss strength primarily a property of the trait itself or of the evolutionary lineage in which the trait is expressed?
